answer.summary: Compares two date strings (YYYYMMDD) part-by-part (Year, then Month, then Day) to determine chronological order. Returns 1 if the first date is later, -1 if the first date is earlier, and 0 if they are equal.

rules.text: If Year of A is greater than Year of B, set result to 1.
If Year of A is less than Year of B, set result to -1.
If Years are equal and Month of A is greater than Month of B, set result to 1.
If Years are equal and Month of A is less than Month of B, set result to -1.
If Years and Months are equal and Day of A is greater than Day of B, set result to 1.
If Years and Months are equal and Day of A is less than Day of B, set result to -1.
